title: Metrics
intro: Aggregated numbers for your tournament. They show counts and team names only: no player names, emails or GPS data.

empty.title: No swims yet
empty.body: Figures appear here once players upload their first swims.

weekly.title: Weekly active swimmers
weekly.hint: Players with a verified swim of 500 m or more, per week (Monday to Sunday, Vietnam time).
weekly.empty: The season has not started yet.

teams.title: Active members per team this week

verification.title: Verification
verification.hint: Share of swim results by outcome.

median.title: Median time to decision
median.minutes: Half of the swims were decided within {minutes} minutes of upload.
median.hours: Half of the swims were decided within {hours} h {minutes} min of upload.
median.none: No swim has been decided yet.

fairness.title: Fairness
fairness.hint: Progress and finish rate of teams grouped by start, team size and active members this week.
